Bank login input:focus box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06) over white (~1.1:1, ~1px) and global caret-color:transparent removes the native cue. Matches.
8px span[role=checkbox] .tick:focus outline:1px solid #f7f7f7 offset 1px on #fff (~1.07:1); fails G195 area+contrast. APG checkbox wired (aria-checked toggles). Matches.
